text:
Between my hands I took

a tiny fistful of earth.

The land-wind was blowing.

The earth returned to earth.


Between your hands you hold me;

I am earth.

The wind airs

your fingers, long with centuries.


And the tiny fistful of sand

-grain by grain, grain by grain-

the great wind carries it away.

translation.title: Between My Hands I Took...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the poem's small scale and its movement from human touch back into elemental earth.
